q.q: Who is the current Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India as of early 2024?
q.x: Girish Chandra Murmu serves as the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. He assumed the office in August 2020.

q.q: Who was awarded the 2024 Abel Prize, often referred to as the 'Nobel Prize of Mathematics'?
q.x: Michel Talagrand was awarded the 2024 Abel Prize for his pioneering contributions to probability theory and functional analysis. The prize is administered by the Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters.

q.q: Who is the recipient of the Nobel Peace Prize 2023?
q.x: Narges Mohammadi was awarded the 2023 Nobel Peace Prize for her fight against the oppression of women in Iran. She is a prominent human rights activist.

q.q: The 'NITI Aayog' released the 'Multidimensional Poverty Index' report. According to the 2024 updates, which state has seen the fastest reduction in the number of multidimensionally poor people?
q.x: According to the NITI Aayog's discussion paper on multidimensional poverty, Uttar Pradesh recorded the largest decline in the number of poor people. Significant progress was also observed in states like Bihar and Madhya Pradesh.

q.q: What is the primary objective of the 'PM Vishwakarma Yojana' launched in 2023?
q.x: The PM Vishwakarma Yojana aims to support traditional artisans and craftspeople by providing them with skill training, toolkits, and collateral-free credit support.

q.q: The 'PM Vishwakarma' scheme, launched in September 2023, is primarily aimed at supporting which group?
q.x: The PM Vishwakarma scheme provides support to artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools. It includes skill training, toolkit incentives, and credit support. The scheme recognizes 18 distinct trades.

q.q: Which Indian state became the first to integrate the 'e-Cabinet' system, allowing the cabinet to hold meetings entirely in a paperless format?
q.x: Sikkim became the first state to launch an e-Cabinet system to streamline decision-making and enhance governance. This initiative is part of the Digital India vision to move towards paperless administrative processes.

q.q: The 'Bharat 6G Alliance' was formed to:
o: Lead the global design and deployment of 6G technology
Install high-speed internet in remote forests
q.x: The Bharat 6G Alliance (B6GA) is a collaborative platform involving public and private sectors to drive research, development, and standardization for 6G technology in India.

q.q: Which city hosted the 18th G20 Summit held in September 2023 under the presidency of India?
q.x: The 18th G20 Heads of State and Government Summit took place in New Delhi at the Bharat Mandapam Convention Centre. The summit concluded with the adoption of the New Delhi Leaders' Declaration.

q.q: Which organization successfully landed the Chandrayaan-3 mission on the lunar south pole?
q.x: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) successfully landed the Chandrayaan-3 lander on the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. India became the first nation to land near the lunar south pole. This mission significantly boosted India's position in space exploration.

q.q: Which Indian state hosted the 37th National Games in 2023?
q.x: The 37th National Games were held in Goa from October 26 to November 9, 2023. It was the first time the state hosted this prestigious multi-sport event.

q.q: What is the name of the lunar mission launched by ISRO that successfully landed on the Moon's south pole in 2023?
q.x: Chandrayaan-3 was India's successful third lunar exploration mission. It made India the first country to land a spacecraft near the lunar south pole.

q.q: Which city was declared the cleanest city in India for the seventh consecutive time in the Swachh Survekshan 2023 awards?
q.x: Indore retained the title of India's cleanest city in the Swachh Survekshan 2023. It shared the top spot with Surat this year. Indore has consistently maintained its top rank in the cleanliness survey since 2017.

q.q: What is the name of the new digital platform launched by the Union Ministry of Education to facilitate the 'One Nation, One Student ID' initiative?
q.x: APAAR, which stands for Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry, is a unique ID created for students to track their academic journey from pre-primary to higher education.

q.q: The 'Vande Bharat Express' trains are manufactured primarily at which facility in India?
q.x: Vande Bharat Express, India's semi-high-speed train, is indigenously designed and manufactured at the Integral Coach Factory (ICF) in Chennai. These trains are part of the 'Make in India' initiative. They offer modern amenities and higher speeds.

q.q: What is the primary objective of 'Operation Ajay', launched by the Government of India in October 2023?
o: To evacuate Indian nationals from Sudan
To provide humanitarian aid to earthquake victims in Turkey
To evacuate Indian nationals from Israel
To combat cyber-terrorism in the border regions
q.x: Operation Ajay was launched by the Indian government to bring back Indian citizens from Israel amidst the escalating conflict between Israel and Hamas. Several chartered flights were operated under this mission.

q.q: What is the primary objective of the 'Mission Life' (Lifestyle for Environment) movement introduced by India?
o: Promotion of sustainable and climate-friendly living
q.x: Mission LiFE was introduced by India at COP26 and launched globally in 2022. It focuses on individual and collective actions to protect and preserve the environment. The movement encourages a shift toward mindful consumption.

q.q: Which Indian athlete won a gold medal in the Javelin Throw at the World Athletics Championships 2023?
q.x: Neeraj Chopra made history by becoming the first Indian to win a gold medal at the World Athletics Championships in Budapest in 2023. His winning throw measured 88.17 meters. This win cemented his status as a global leader in the sport.

q.q: The 'Vande Bharat' sleeper train project, officially named 'Vande Sleeper', is planned to be manufactured by which entity in partnership with Titagarh Rail Systems?
q.x: BEML Limited has been awarded the contract to design and manufacture the Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets. This project is a major step in upgrading the long-distance rail travel experience in India.

q.q: Which company developed the AI chatbot 'ChatGPT'?
q.x: OpenAI is the research organization behind the development of ChatGPT. It has become one of the most popular generative AI tools globally.

q.q: Who is the current Chairperson of the 16th Finance Commission of India?
q.x: Arvind Panagariya, a former Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog, was appointed as the Chairperson of the 16th Finance Commission in late 2023. The commission is responsible for recommending the distribution of taxes between the Union and the States.

q.q: The 'Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra' was launched by the Government of India primarily to:
o: Raise awareness about government welfare schemes
Encourage digital literacy in rural areas
q.x: The Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra is a nationwide campaign aimed at raising awareness and ensuring the saturation of government schemes to reach all intended beneficiaries.

q.q: Who became the first Indian to be inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in 2024?
q.x: Leander Paes became the first Asian man to be inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame. The ceremony took place in early 2024, honoring his legendary career as a doubles specialist.

q.q: Who was the first Indian sportsperson to win a gold medal at the World Athletics Championships?
q.x: Neeraj Chopra made history in 2023 by becoming the first Indian to win a gold medal at the World Athletics Championships. This was achieved in the men's javelin throw event in Budapest.

q.q: Which space agency successfully launched the 'Aditya-L1' mission to study the Sun?
q.x: Aditya-L1 is the first Indian space-based observatory to study the Sun, launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) in September 2023.

q.q: Who was appointed as the new Managing Director and CEO of Tata Electronics in 2024?
q.x: Randhir Thakur was appointed as the CEO and MD of Tata Electronics. He has previously held leadership roles at Intel and plays a critical role in Tata's semiconductor manufacturing ambitions.

q.q: Which Indian state launched the 'Mukhyamantri Vayoshree Yojana' in 2024 to provide financial assistance to senior citizens?
q.x: The Government of Maharashtra launched the Mukhyamantri Vayoshree Yojana in 2024. This scheme provides financial aid of 3,000 rupees to senior citizens suffering from age-related disabilities to purchase assistive devices.

q.q: The 'Statue of Equality' in Hyderabad commemorates which philosopher?
q.x: The Statue of Equality is a monument dedicated to the 11th-century Bhakti saint Sri Ramanujacharya. It is located in Muchintal, near Hyderabad.

q.q: Which Indian athlete won the first-ever Gold Medal for India in Athletics at the World Athletics Championships?
q.x: Neeraj Chopra made history by winning the gold medal in the men's javelin throw at the 2023 World Athletics Championships in Budapest. He is the first Indian to achieve this feat.

q.q: In the context of India's climate goals, what does the 'Panchamrit' strategy, announced at COP26, include?
o: Five distinct goals to reach net-zero by 2070
Five major solar power projects in desert regions
Five targets to reduce plastic waste across Indian cities
Five initiatives to increase forest cover in Himalayas
q.x: Panchamrit refers to the five-point action plan announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at COP26 to address climate change. A key goal is to reach net-zero carbon emissions by 2070.

q.q: What was the theme of the International Yoga Day 2024?
q.x: The theme for International Yoga Day 2024 was 'Yoga for Self and Society'. It emphasizes the individual and collective impact of practicing yoga.

q.q: Which Indian state recently implemented the 'Gruha Lakshmi' scheme, providing a monthly financial assistance of 2,000 rupees to women heads of households?
q.x: The Gruha Lakshmi scheme is a flagship welfare program launched by the Karnataka government. It aims to provide financial empowerment to women heads of families across the state.

q.q: The 'Global Biofuel Alliance' (GBA) was launched on the sidelines of the G20 Summit in New Delhi. Which of the following countries are founding members of this initiative?
q.x: The Global Biofuel Alliance was launched by India, the USA, and Brazil to boost the use of clean energy. The alliance aims to accelerate the adoption of biofuels globally to help achieve net-zero emission targets.

q.q: As of late 2023, which Indian space mission successfully achieved the soft landing on the lunar south pole, making India the first nation to do so?
q.x: Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed on the lunar surface on August 23, 2023. This feat made India the fourth country to land on the moon and the first to touch down near the lunar south pole.

q.q: Which city is known as the host of the G20 Summit held in India in 2023?
q.x: New Delhi hosted the G20 Leaders' Summit in September 2023 at the Bharat Mandapam. India held the G20 presidency for the year 2023.

q.q: What is the name of the scheme launched by the Government of India to provide credit support to street vendors?
q.x: PM SVANidhi (Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi) was launched to provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors. It aims to help them resume their businesses after the COVID-19 pandemic.

q.q: Who was awarded the prestigious 2023 Nobel Prize in Literature?
q.x: Norwegian author Jon Fosse was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature for 2023 for his innovative plays and prose which give voice to the unsayable.

q.q: What is the primary objective of the 'PM-Suryaghar: Muft Bijli Yojana' launched in early 2024?
o: Providing free piped water to rural households
Providing free electricity via rooftop solar panels
q.x: The PM-Suryaghar: Muft Bijli Yojana aims to provide up to 300 units of free electricity per month to one crore households by installing rooftop solar systems. The government provides substantial subsidies to make the installation affordable.

q.q: Which organization released the 'Global Risks Report 2024' which highlighted misinformation and disinformation as top global risks?
q.x: The World Economic Forum publishes the Global Risks Report annually ahead of its meeting in Davos. The 2024 report emphasized that AI-generated misinformation is a significant short-term threat to global stability.

q.q: Who was appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner of India in 2024?
q.x: Rajiv Kumar assumed charge as the 25th Chief Election Commissioner of India. He has been serving in the commission since 2020.

q.q: Who won the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2023?
q.x: Australia won their sixth ICC Men's Cricket World Cup title in 2023 by defeating India in the final match held at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad.

q.q: What is the name of the portal launched by the Government of India for the seamless processing of birth and death registrations?
q.x: The Civil Registration System (CRS) portal is the official platform managed by the Registrar General of India for registering births and deaths. It aims to digitize the process and make it accessible nationwide. This portal streamlines civil data management.

q.q: The 'Digital India' initiative was launched in which year?
q.x: The Digital India campaign was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on July 1, 2015. Its primary goal is to ensure government services are available to citizens electronically through improved online infrastructure. It has significantly increased internet connectivity across rural India.

q.q: Which country officially became the 32nd member of NATO in March 2024?
q.x: Sweden officially joined NATO on March 7, 2024, ending decades of military non-alignment. This move followed the successful ratification of its accession protocol by all existing NATO member states.

q.q: Which space agency launched the 'IMAP' (Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe) mission in 2024?
q.x: NASA's IMAP mission is designed to study the heliosphere, the region of space influenced by the Sun. It aims to collect particles that originate from outside our solar system.

q.q: Which Indian city was declared the 'Cleanest City' in the Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023?
q.x: Indore retained its title as the cleanest city in India for the seventh consecutive year in the Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023.

q.q: The 'Exercise MILAN 2024', a major multilateral naval exercise, was hosted by which country?
q.x: India hosted the 12th edition of the MILAN naval exercise in Visakhapatnam in February 2024. It is a biennial multilateral naval exercise that aims to enhance professional interaction and maritime cooperation.

q.q: Which day is celebrated as 'National Sports Day' in India?
q.x: National Sports Day is celebrated annually on 29th August in India to commemorate the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.

q.q: Who was awarded the 2023 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences for having advanced our understanding of women's labour market outcomes?
q.x: Claudia Goldin was awarded the Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences in 2023. Her research provided the first comprehensive account of women’s earnings and labour market participation through the centuries.

q.q: Which company became the first private sector entity in India to manufacture C-295 transport aircraft in collaboration with Airbus?
q.x: Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL) is manufacturing the C-295 aircraft in Vadodara, Gujarat. This is the first time a military aircraft will be manufactured in India by a private consortium.

q.q: The 'Global Biofuel Alliance' was announced on the sidelines of which international summit?
q.x: The Global Biofuel Alliance was launched by India along with other member nations during the G20 Summit held in New Delhi in September 2023.

q.q: The 'Constitution Day' in India is celebrated on which date every year?
q.x: Constitution Day, also known as Samvidhan Divas, is celebrated on November 26 to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India in 1949.

q.q: Which country assumed the G20 Presidency for the year 2023?
q.x: India held the G20 Presidency for the year 2023, with the theme 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'. The summit concluded with the adoption of the New Delhi Declaration. Brazil took over the presidency from India for 2024.

q.q: Who was appointed as the 50th Chief Justice of India in November 2022?
q.x: Justice Dhananjaya Yeshwant Chandrachud took oath as the 50th Chief Justice of India on November 9, 2022. He succeeded Justice U.U. Lalit. His tenure is one of the longest in recent years.

q.q: What is the name of the new digital platform launched by the Election Commission of India to help voters check their registration status?
q.x: The Voter Helpline App is the official mobile application provided by the Election Commission of India. It allows users to search for their names in the electoral roll, find polling stations, and file complaints.

q.q: What is the name of the operation launched by India to evacuate its citizens from Israel during the 2023 conflict?
q.x: Operation Ajay was launched by the Indian government to facilitate the return of Indian citizens from Israel amidst the escalating conflict in October 2023.
